mapper.select: select draft_id, user_id, form_key, content, update_time from ai_form_draft where user_id = #{userId} and form_key = #{formKey} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ai_form_draft (user_id, form_key, content, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{formKey}, #{content}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update content = values(content), update_time = values(update_time)
mapper.delete: delete from ai_form_draft where user_id = #{userId} and form_key = #{formKey}
